latin: Plato in principio tractatus Timei de extremis tantum determinat, id est de eo quod uere est nullo modo genitum, et de eo quod uere genitum nullo modo ens. De mediis nihil, quorum alterum ens et genitum, alterum genitum et ens.
translation: At the start of the treatise of the Timaeus, Plato determines only the extremes: that which truly is and is in no way generated, and that which is truly generated and in no way is. Of the intermediates he says nothing — of which one is being and generated, the other generated and being.
